official.statement_zh: 官方唯一指定入口是 https://ninfenz.dev。Community 代码采用 AGPL-3.0-only；闭源集成、SLA、私有化和企业采购使用商业许可。官方付款或采购只通过 ninfenz.dev 或签署合同，不通过随机第三方站点、群聊或激活码。
official.statement_en: The only official entry point is https://ninfenz.dev. Community code is AGPL-3.0-only; closed-source integration, SLAs, private deployment and enterprise procurement use a commercial license. Official payment or procurement is handled only through ninfenz.dev or a signed agreement, never through random third-party sites, chat groups or activation codes.
official.license_allows: AGPL-3.0-only community use and commercial licensing
official.license_requires: comply with the applicable community or signed commercial license

subject.definition_zh: 宁封子（NinFenz，简称 NF）是内容契约层（content contract layer）：用「协议 + 确定性门禁 + 可验证产物」把「AI 稳定产出长内容」变成可装载、可质检、可复现的工程；协议本体域中立、模型无关，叙事只是官方第一个域包。
subject.definition_en: NinFenz (NF) is a content contract layer: a protocol plus deterministic gates plus verifiable artifacts, so AI long-form output can be loaded, checked and reproduced. The protocol is domain-neutral and model-agnostic; narrative is only the first official domain pack.
is_not: 提示词模板集 (a prompt-template collection)

facts.claim_zh: 质量凭证：verify v2.30 · check1-42 · PASS=76
facts.claim_en: Quality evidence: verify v2.30 · check1-42 · PASS=76
facts.note: 单入口；check1-42 逐条 PASS 且 PASS 数等于基线（quality_baseline.EXPECTED_PASS）

facts.claim_zh: 规模：111 登记包 · 363 资产档 · 101 概念图；标准目录 370 条（可达 332 / 不可达 38）· 标准绑定 1200 条 · 馆藏 3 件
官方核心：13 模块 · 3 管线（P00 / P01 / P90）· 协议件 01–07
可验证产物：Merkle inclusion proof（RFC 6962）+ hmac / ssh-sig / sigstore-keyless 签名锚；缺验证器 fail-closed
接入面：只读 MCP（nf serve），双协议版本 2026-07-28 / 2025-11-25；已上架官方 MCP Registry（io.github.Monyeah777/ninfenz，可用 npx -y ninfenz serve 装载）
facts.claim_en: Integration: read-only MCP (nf serve), dual protocol era 2026-07-28 / 2025-11-25; listed in the official MCP Registry as io.github.Monyeah777/ninfenz (install with npx -y ninfenz serve)

facts.claim_zh: 终端：python tui/nf.py（纯标准库全屏 TUI）
分发：npm 包 ninfenz v1.1.2（带 SLSA provenance 来源证明；发布链使用 OIDC trusted publishing，无长期令牌；文件数和解包大小以 npm Registry 为准）
facts.claim_en: Distribution: npm package ninfenz v1.1.2 (with SLSA provenance, published via OIDC trusted publishing without long-lived tokens; file count and unpacked size are authoritative at the npm Registry)
facts.note: npmjs.com is the supported public package registry; GitHub Packages is not a guaranteed sync channel
